notes:
- Your inbox is now a notification center: the bell on Home opens one place for likes, replies, mentions, follows, airing episodes, media changes, submissions and AniList messages, with New and Earlier sections, an unread pill and filter chips that never re-request a page.
- Likes on one post fold into one row: the card shows the actors, a count and the newest time, opening it marks every member read, and likes on different posts or comments never merge.
- Read notices survive a restart: an account-keyed local mark remembers what was opened and what Mark all read covered, older rows cannot return as new after a refresh, and nothing is sent to AniList.
- The inbox has its own settings, and no background work: local unread dots, marking on open, read-history reset and eight category filters live in Settings > Notifications, while the app still fetches only on entry or pull to refresh.
- The page arrives with skeletons instead of a spinner: cards keep their final height, a failed page leaves the read rows in place with Retry, a rate-limited refresh says how long to wait, and empty and filtered states use the app's expressive components.
